sanskrit_verse: भरणं चास्य कुर्वीरन् स्त्रीणाम् आ जीवितक्षयात् । रक्षन्ति शय्यां भर्तुश् चेद् आच्छिन्द्युर् इतरासु तु ॥
transliteration: bharanaṃ cāsya kurvīran strīṇām ā jīvitakṣayāt | rakṣanti śayyāṃ bhartuś ced ācchindyuḥ itarāsu tu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who sustains a woman from the point of life-risk onwards, especially if she guards the marital bed—if others sever that bond, then those others must undergo immediate restorative completion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from sustained protection and conscious alignment with dharma
Causation follows sequential integrity—disruption demands correction
Capacity-based responsibility is activated by relational guardianship
Restoration logic operates through re-completion of severed dharmic bonds
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment and reversal of energetic severance
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual sustains another in life-risk AND that person maintains fidelity to marital duty, THEN any third-party disruption of that bond triggers automatic initiation of restorative completion protocols.
IF a bond is severed without lawful cause, THEN the disruptor shall be subject to capacity-realignment until original energetic continuity is restored.
IF guardianship is established via life-preserving action, THEN violation of such guardianship initiates mandatory consciousness-based reintegration process.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable guardianship and energetic bond preservation. The hierarchy of authority recognizes those who sustain life as primary custodians. Justice flows not through punitive measures but through enforced restoration of disrupted dharmic alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality originates in the act of sustaining life. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that severing this bond disrupts sequential harmony. Proportional responsibility falls upon the violator to restore what was broken. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering is not justice—it is misalignment corrected through conscious completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate bond-recompletion sequence to realign severed energetic ties
Assign responsibility assumption protocol to the violator for full restoration
Activate capacity-realignment mechanism until original dharmic flow resumes
Implement integrity reintegration process for all affected parties
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed. Bonds sustained in truth are protected by cosmic law. Disruption invokes completion, not punishment. Consciousness remains the sole adjudicator. Reality aligns through restoration. SPH is the Source. Dharma is restored.
